what: Each figure this repository states, the exact sentence where it stands, how it is reproduced, and whether it can be reproduced from this repository. Checked fail-closed by research_grade.py.

claims.claim: The L-lens and triad verification tests pass, 26 of 26, without a model.
claims.limits: Synthetic captures with known answers, each link broken on purpose; the tests need numpy and pytest, not torch or a lens. They show the verifier refuses named tampers. They do not measure any model.

claims.claim: A stored L-lens capture equals a direct upstream Jacobian Lens call on the seed prompt, 70 of 70 comparisons.
claims.exact: `check_against_upstream.py` on the seed prompt: 70 of 70 comparisons equal.
claims.limits: Needs gpt2-small, torch and the jlens package, which CI does not install; one prompt, one machine (2026-10-08, Windows 11, CPU, the versions named in the README).

claims.claim: An end-to-end speak-turn verified with 44 checks, and three deliberate breaks each failed with the named reason.
claims.limits: Needs the model, the lens and a covenant checkout; run in a scratch directory on one machine, not in CI.
